en: This is Space Conqueror's Park, a few hundred miles south of Moscow.
zh: 這裡是太空征服者公園，位於莫斯科以南幾百英里。
ja: ここは宇宙征服者公園で、モスクワの南数百マイルにあります。
local: This is Space Conqueror's Park, a few hundred miles south of Moscow.
ja_pron: Koko wa uchū seifuku-sha kōen de, Mosukuwa no minami sūhyaku mairu ni arimasu.
native: This is Space Conqueror's Park, a few hundred miles south of Moscow.

en: It's a celebration of Russia's achievements in space exploration.
zh: 這是對俄羅斯太空探索成就的慶祝。
ja: これはロシアの宇宙探査の成果を祝うものです。
local: It's a celebration of Russia's achievements in space exploration.
ja_pron: Kore wa Roshia no uchū tansa no seika o iwau mono desu.
native: It's a celebration of Russia's achievements in space exploration.

en: And the reason the park was built here is that 60 years ago this place became part of a remarkable story.
zh: 這個公園建在這裡的原因是，60年前這裡成為了一個非凡故事的一部分。
ja: この公園がここに建てられた理由は、60年前にこの場所が素晴らしい物語の一部となったからです。
local: And the reason the park was built here is that 60 years ago this place became part of a remarkable story.
ja_pron: Kono kōen ga koko ni taterareta riyū wa, rokujū nen mae ni kono basho ga subarashii monogatari no ichibu to natta kara desu.
native: And the reason the park was built here is that 60 years ago this place became part of a remarkable story.

en: On the 12th of April 1961, a Soviet Air Force pilot, Yuri Gagarin, became the first human to blast into space.
zh: 1961年4月12日，蘇聯空軍飛行員尤里·加加林成為第一個進入太空的人類。
ja: 1961年4月12日、ソビエト空軍のパイロット、ユーリ・ガガーリンが初めて宇宙に飛び立った人間となりました。
local: On the 12th of April 1961, a Soviet Air Force pilot, Yuri Gagarin, became the first human to blast into space.
ja_pron: Sen kyūhyaku rokujū ichi nen shigatsu jūnichi, Sobieto kūgun no pairotto, Yūri Gagārin ga hajimete uchū ni tobitatta ningen to narimashita.
native: On the 12th of April 1961, a Soviet Air Force pilot, Yuri Gagarin, became the first human to blast into space.

en: And on his descent, Gagarin parachuted out of the tiny space capsule he was in.
zh: 在返回過程中，加加林從他所乘坐的小型太空艙中跳傘出來。
ja: そして帰還時、ガガーリンは乗っていた小さな宇宙カプセルからパラシュートで降りました。
local: And on his descent, Gagarin parachuted out of the tiny space capsule he was in.
ja_pron: Soshite kikan-ji, Gagārin wa notte ita chiisana uchū kapuseru kara parashūto de orimashita.
native: And on his descent, Gagarin parachuted out of the tiny space capsule he was in.

en: And he landed here, this was farmland at the time,
zh: 他降落在這裡，當時這裡是農田，
ja: そして彼はここに着陸しました。当時ここは農地でした。
local: And he landed here, this was farmland at the time,
ja_pron: Soshite kare wa koko ni chakuriku shimashita. Tōji koko wa nōchi deshita.
native: And he landed here, this was farmland at the time,

en: much to the surprise of a five-year-old girl who was out in the fields, planting potatoes.
zh: 這讓一位在田裡種馬鈴薯的五歲小女孩非常驚訝。
ja: 畑でジャガイモを植えていた5歳の女の子はとても驚きました。
local: much to the surprise of a five-year-old girl who was out in the fields, planting potatoes.
ja_pron: Hatake de jagaimo o uete ita go-sai no onnanoko wa totemo odorokimashita.
native: much to the surprise of a five-year-old girl who was out in the fields, planting potatoes.

en: And he was a very powerful person, a very powerful person.
zh: 他是一個非常有影響力的人，非常有影響力的人。
ja: 彼はとても力強い人物でした、とても力強い人物でした。
local: And he was a very powerful person, a very powerful person.
ja_pron: Kare wa totemo chikara tsuyoi jinbutsu deshita, totemo chikara tsuyoi jinbutsu deshita.
native: And he was a very powerful person, a very powerful person.

en: What do you remember most about this space man who was suddenly standing in front of you?
zh: 你最記得這位突然站在你面前的太空人什麼？
ja: 突然目の前に立ったこの宇宙飛行士について、最も覚えていることは何ですか？
local: What do you remember most about this space man who was suddenly standing in front of you?
ja_pron: Totsuzen me no mae ni tatta kono uchū hikōshi ni tsuite, mottomo oboete iru koto wa nan desu ka?
native: What do you remember most about this space man who was suddenly standing in front of you?

en: The next call was at Admiralty House to see the Prime Minister.
zh: 下一個拜訪地點是海軍部大樓，去見首相。
ja: 次の訪問先はアドミラルティハウスで、首相に会いました。
local: The next call was at Admiralty House to see the Prime Minister.
ja_pron: Tsugi no hōmon-saki wa Adomiraru-ti Hausu de, shushō ni aimashita.
native: The next call was at Admiralty House to see the Prime Minister.

en: Mr. McMillan said he's a delightful fellow, which just about sums up what everybody thought.
zh: 麥克米蘭先生說他是個令人愉快的人，這大致總結了大家的想法。
ja: マクミラン氏は彼を魅力的な人物だと言い、皆がそう思っていたことをよく表しています。
local: Mr. McMillan said he's a delightful fellow, which just about sums up what everybody thought.
ja_pron: Makumiran-shi wa kare o miryokuteki na jinbutsu da to ii, mina ga sō omotte ita koto o yoku arawashite imasu.
native: Mr. McMillan said he's a delightful fellow, which just about sums up what everybody thought.

en: How does it feel to have been part of history?
zh: 成為歷史的一部分感覺如何？
ja: 歴史の一部になった気持ちはどうですか？
local: How does it feel to have been part of history?
ja_pron: Rekishi no ichibu ni natta kimochi wa dō desu ka?
native: How does it feel to have been part of history?

en: Hundreds of people have since travelled into space, but only one man was first.
zh: 此後有數百人進入太空，但只有一個人是第一個。
ja: その後、何百人もの人が宇宙に旅立ちましたが、最初に行ったのはただ一人の男性でした。
local: Hundreds of people have since travelled into space, but only one man was first.
ja_pron: Sono ato, nanbyakunin mo no hito ga uchū ni tabidachimashita ga, saisho ni itta no wa tada hitori no dansei deshita.
native: Hundreds of people have since travelled into space, but only one man was first.

en: And Russians are intensely proud of the fact that it was their guy, Yuri Gagarin, who made history with his flight to the stars.
zh: 俄羅斯人非常自豪，因為是他們的人尤里·加加林用他的星際飛行創造了歷史。
ja: ロシア人は、自分たちのユーリ・ガガーリンが星への飛行で歴史を作ったことを非常に誇りに思っています。
local: And Russians are intensely proud of the fact that it was their guy, Yuri Gagarin, who made history with his flight to the stars.
ja_pron: Roshiajin wa, jibuntachi no Yūri Gagārin ga hoshi e no hikō de rekishi o tsukutta koto o hijō ni hokori ni omotte imasu.
native: And Russians are intensely proud of the fact that it was their guy, Yuri Gagarin, who made history with his flight to the stars.
